limitations: Only original ArtifactStore root/files directories are captured and rechecked; index file inode/bytes, complete inventory, full v2 storage/retention graph and independent volume authority remain unverified
Sequential root/files stat and realpath checks are not an atomic snapshot or handle-relative confinement, and do not prove rejection of arbitrary swap-and-restore timing
The synthetic BigInt collision model is not evidence of an actual NTFS same-Number-projection directory replacement
Same original-directory reopening is tested in one process; this batch does not prove cross-process clone routing, rollback protection or protected installation pin state
A fresh independent genuine composition may adopt its own cloned local data; its different directory digest does not establish tenant-wide uniqueness or independent generation provenance
Original v2 verify/read can acquire maintenance locks and recover already-authorized data; only the directory-boundary operation itself is read-only
Persisted index descriptors, restriction records, original artifact formats and localCompositionDigest remain unchanged; the new partial digest does not authenticate a caller storageGraphDigest
No independent installation approval, protected highwater/pin, fixed business router, producer receipt authority, candidate alias or Registry release source gate was enabled
Local test HMAC/manifest authorities and Windows regression do not validate production keys, external WORM, actual model/cost experiments, power-loss durability, Linux/macOS or release matrices
